storylines.description: Disney's "Wish" trailer presents two intertwined storylines: Asha's Journey and King Magnifico's Manipulation. Asha's journey, composing the central narrative, follows her quest for hope and change against the backdrop of a magical world. The supplementary storyline revolves around King Magnifico's manipulative control over the wishes of others, presenting the dichotomy of power and purity. The non-storyline introductory scene serves as the narrative's establishment.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello everyone and welcome back to my channel. Today I'm going to break down the teaser trailer for Wish and hopefully I will find all of the Disney Easter eggs.
After the Disney 100 logo is shown, we see an aerial shot of the setting of the film The Kingdom of Rosas, which features multiple buildings in shades of cream, purple, blue and green.
The Kingdom of Rosas is a fantastical land located off the Iberian Peninsula, which is shared by Spain and Portugal.
The first thing I noticed in this shot was the Bell Tower, which is a reference to the hunchback of Notre Dame.
The shot even has a similar angle to the one featured in the song out there.
Additionally, there are seagulls flying around which is a reference to the Little Mermaid.
There is also a woman standing on a balcony, but I don't think the cheese amane character.
After this, we see a lower shot of the Kingdom with a young child with blonde hair flying a kite, which I think is a reference to Mary Poppins.
In the background, there is a man juggling a woman playing guitar and a couple dancing in a Spanish style.
It gives me marketplace vibes from Aladdin.
Next we see Asha and her good Valentino standing on the balcony of the castle.
But I do not think that she lives there as Ariana de Bose has been referring to her as a heroine, rather than a princess.
Valentino then blows out a dandelion that Asha is holding and the wind carries it away.
This is a reference to Beauty and the Beast, where Belle does the exact same thing.
Next Asha is seen looking up at the castle.
I feel like she is going on a mission to see King Magnifico about a wish that she has.
We then cut to inside the castle and Asha is now with the King.
On the ground, there is a sun which I think is a reference to Corona's crest in Tanglet.
There are also some circular symbols linked to Disney films such as this trident from the Little Mermaid and Maui's hook from Moana.
After this, we see some magical blue balls fall from the roof, which I presume contain the wishes of people who have sought help from the King.
The wishes then surround Asha as she looks at them in wonder.
The balls immediately reminded me of the bubbles in Cinderella, but they also look like the element symbols in Frozen 2 and the dragon gem in Rhyr and the last dragon.
Next we see King Magnifico standing alone in this same room looking outside.
On the tables, you can see some magical potions in a lab-like setting.
There are many magic potions in Disney films such as in Alice in Wonderland, the Emperor's new group Snow White and Hercules.
Potions are normally used by villains confirming that the King is the bad guy.
King Magnifico then glares at the camera and gives an evil look as a green light appears in his eyes.
This color is associated with several Disney villains such as Maleficent in Sleeping Beauty, Scar and the Lion King and Dr. Faciliate in the Princess and the Frog.
This specific close-up shot is near identical to ones of Lanyl, Tremaine and Cinderella and Ursula in the Little Mermaid.
In the description of the trailer, it says that people come from everywhere to give their wishes to a magical King who promises to grant their deepest desires.
Someday, only he can decide which wishes will come true and when.
So basically, he's denying people their wishes on purpose which is pretty evil.
We then see Arsha and Valentino running away from the castle and into a forest while King Magnifico doesn't evil laugh.
Forest feature in heaps of Disney films such as Snow White and the Seven Dewarfs, Sleeping Beauty, Bambi and Frozen 2.
Next, Arsha is seen wishing upon a star like Jopero did in Pinocchio and Tiana did in the Princess and the Frog.
Additionally, she is standing on a tree that looks similar to Granmother Willow from Pogahontus.
A beam of light then appears and Arsha and Valentino block their eyes.
Arsha is then seen back on the ground and starrushes past her.
It then circles around her as Arsha leans back against a well which is the wishing well from Snow White.
Arsha then says what was that and runs after starr.
After this, there is a good closeup of starr and the forest looks exactly like the one from Sleeping Beauty in this shot.
Starr then brings some pink flowers to life, referencing the talking flowers from Alice in Wonderland.
After this, there is a closeup of Arsha looking concerned because Valentino is eating the star's magic.
She flinks it away from him and blows it but Valentino still manages to eat it.
This magic looks similar to the pixie dust used to make the characters fly in Peter Pan.
This magic has granted Valentino's wish the ability to talk.
He originally thinks it didn't work but then realizes that his wish is granted and acts surprised that his voice is so low.
After this, Arsha's main song starts playing.
It was originally called More For Us but it has been renamed to this wish which I like better.
It has also been announced that Benjamin Rice will be writing the songs alongside the previously confirmed Julia Michaels.
Disney then boasts about the amazing films that they have done, like Frozen, The Lion King and Moana.
Valentino is seen looking up in wonder and flying flowers in the trees.
This kind of reminds me of Gail moving around the leaves in Frozen 2.
Arsha is then seen walking through the grandmother Willow tree vines and I think this might be during her big I Want song.
The trailer then cuts back to Valentino playing in the trees.
Disney then shows more of their famous titles including Beauty in the Beast, Cinderella and Encanto.
The next shot is of King Magnifico in front of a Doring crowd and he releases some crystal sparkles and stars that I presume are wishes.
The crowd is loving this and as you can see from this shot there are thousands of people at this event.
We then see a group of people who are main characters.
I think that these seven young people are Arsha's friends who represent the Seven Dwarfs.
This one is Sneasy, this one is Happy, this one is Bachelvall, this one is Grumpy, this one is Dopey, this one is Duck and this one is Sleepy.
This was discovered first by David Gilson on Twitter.
Here you can see Arsha's mum holding Valentino.
She is wearing purple like Arsha with hints of yellow.
Additionally she has purple lipstick and short hair.
There is also this older man who has white hair and a beard.
He has on a yellow and green outfit with a purple cape.
I think he could potentially be the father or grandfather of one of these younger characters.
We then get some text informing us that wishes a story a century in the making.
As Walt Disney Animation Studios has been making films for 100 years.
Arsha then appears to be singing while looking up at the stars through an archway.
We Valentino is standing behind her.
I think this takes place in the castle and these green lights indicate again that something is not right in the kingdom.
Arsha is surrounded by birds which is a staple in Disney fairy tales.
They fly upwards at once and Arsha stares at them as they travel into the sky.
One bird hangs back to be with Valentino and he seems delighted to have a new animal friend.
We then see the magical wishing balls again with the king's hand in the shot.
There is then a wider shot of him with Arsha and he seems to have the power to move these balls with his hands.
Again you can see the lap of magical potions on the tables.
Next there is a shot of Arsha with a bunny surrounded by colorful bonaflides.
This references the coloring in polka-hontas, the bonaflides in in canto and bumper from bambi.
After this Arsha is seen riding a grain horse towards the palace.
Horses feature prominently in Disney films such as Tangled, Sleeping Beauty, Frozen, Cinderella and Milan.
This scene takes place at sunset which could signal that Arsha is running out of time
as Ariel misses her deadline in the little mermaid as she doesn't get her kiss by sunset.
Next we have a Tangled reference with five of Arsha's friends propelling down the castle with ropes.
This is exactly what Flinrator does to steal the crown in Tangled.
I think that these characters could be attempting to free people's wishes.
After this we see Star flying into the sky and then it explodes like a firework,
a regular occurrence at Disney Thingparks.
You can see the shoulder here of the king and he is riding a white horse with gold on his head.
He looks similar to Maximus another royal horse.
Our final look at the movie is of Arsha looking up at the stars
before the new logo is revealed in which the letters look like sparkling crystals.
An alternate logo was revealed in a new movie poster in which the letters are made of tiny stars.
There are also colorful beams of light coming down from the sky.
Anyway those all for today like this video if you liked it and please subscribe.
It would mean so much to me.
Bye now and have a magical day!
